rows.en: Touya: "I wonder where we're flying over now."
Touya: "...Where the hell did she go?"
Touya: "Are you all right? What happened!?"
Touya: "Hey, calm down and talk properly!!"
Yamato: "H-H-H-Help me! She's going to eat me!"
What the hell are you... Huh? She's gone..."
Touya: "Whoa! When did you get there!? H-Hey! Stop!
Calm down. She won't taste good raw."
Touya: "What the hell is going on?"
Yamato: "That's what I want to know!"
Touya: "Come to think of it, she said she'd 'go feral' when she got hungry...
Touya: "I saw you biting Yamato's neck.
At the very least, it didn't look like you were playing."
Leone: "Ha ha, ha ha ha ha..."
Touya: "Don't try to laugh it off."
<FC:3C:3E><FC:04:3C:FF:15> Um... When I get hungry past a certain point,
I can't settle down until I eat the prey in front of me."
Touya: "What are you, a wild animal?"
I don't think this'll happen very often anymore."
Yamato: "So it will still happen sometimes!"
Yamato: "I'd say the danger's pretty high."
Touya: "Why do you get so hungry?"
No matter how much I eat, I get hungry again right away.
I usually eat eight meals a day, but they only have three here..."
<FC:3C:3E><FC:04:3C:16:10><FC:01:3E><FC:04:3C:1C:11><FC:02:3E><FC:04:3C:1C:13> I'll be more careful from now on. Forgive me? Please?"
Yamato: "...You won't try to eat me again?"
Leone: "Of course not! I'll carry some rations
Let's shake hands and make up."
I don't know my own strength...
Maybe that's because I eat so much too?"
Leone: "Now that we've cleared up that misunderstanding,
I'll go get something to eat. See you!"

review_batches.context: Read all74 rows. Missing Yamato flees hungry Leone, Touya intervenes; Leone explains extreme hunger/eight meals, apologizes and promises to carry rations. Awkward handshake and food departure finish.
review_batches.decisions: Keep comic threat and actual stated neck bite without invented gore or injury; no real animal-harm procedure added. Her hungry/feral state and food-strength theory remain character explanation/questions, not a diagnosis. Preserve all eight FC controls,44-period pause, cat vocalizations versus speech, rare-versus-never caveat, eight-versus-three meals and request direction.
